# CardForge

> CardForge is a free, open-source, local-first web application for designing print-ready and digital business cards.

CardForge runs in the browser without an account. Designs and uploaded images stay in browser storage unless a user explicitly exports or shares them. It supports freeform front-and-back editing, professional templates, customizable QR codes, vCard output, PNG and SVG export, and print-ready PDF export with bleed and crop marks.

## Important boundaries

- The hosted app has no user accounts, analytics, advertising, or server-side design database.
- Share-link payloads are encoded, not encrypted. Anyone who receives a link can read and forward its selected content.
- CardForge is not represented as FERPA, COPPA, HIPAA, payment, identity, or records-retention compliant.
- Generated cards should be reviewed for content, accessibility, QR scanning, dimensions, bleed, and print-provider requirements.
